purpose: Document an access-level recheck of official sources before requesting additional private data.

required: vehicle or receiving-vessel pressure and temperature
initial conditions, units and reuse terms
eligibility_rule.claim_boundary: A report, plot, aggregate KPI or software description is not counted as a raw full-loop holdout.

sources.observation: The page describes transient station-to-FCEV pressure, temperature and mass-flow modeling and validation datasets, but does not publish a downloadable rights-cleared raw logger cohort.
The manual documents model inputs and validation context; it is not a machine-readable station-to-vehicle measurement archive.
The facility description confirms representative H70/H35 pressure, temperature and flow instrumentation, but no public raw trace download or reuse contract was found on the page.
The public report contains plots and aggregate heavy-duty fueling results, not synchronized raw station, dispenser and vehicle rows.
The page reports test capability and known data gaps; it does not expose a downloadable synchronized logger archive.
The software and apparatus support station performance testing, but the public page does not provide a rights-cleared full-loop measurement cohort.
The API exposes layout, availability and usage context, not synchronized pressure, temperature, mass-flow and vehicle-tank time series.
Temperature and pressure files are useful component evidence, but do not include a station-to-vehicle refueling channel contract.

claim_boundary: This access check records what the cited public sources expose. It adds no validation score, does not change a frozen holdout, and does not imply that component measurements validate station-to-vehicle behavior.
